result.instructions: Tools for awork, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are active in awork, and who is on each one?"; "Show the open tasks in the project 'Website relaunch' with their due dates."; "Log 90 minutes of design work for me on the task 'Homepage concepts' today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes awork data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run awork_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run awork_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run awork_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. awork_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: awork_whoami
tools.title: Current user and workspace
tools.description: Return the user and workspace that the API key belongs to (id, workspace name and url). Good first call to confirm the connection. awork API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: awork_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List workspace users with their names, roles and status. Use the ids in other tools (for example as the userId of a time entry). awork API: GET /users.

orderby.description: Sort expression, as in the awork ordering docs (developers.awork.com/ordering).

filterby.description: Filter expression, as in the awork filtering docs (developers.awork.com/filtering).

tools.name: awork_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects in the workspace (the API key has admin-level access), with status, dates and budget fields. awork API: GET /projects.

orderby.description: Sort expression, as in the awork ordering docs (developers.awork.com/ordering).

filterby.description: Filter expression, as in the awork filtering docs (developers.awork.com/filtering).

tools.name: awork_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Return one project by id, including its status, dates and members. awork API: GET /projects/{projectId}.

project_id.description: The project id (UUID, from a list call).

tools.name: awork_list_task_lists
tools.title: List task lists of a project
tools.description: List the task lists of one project. Their ids are needed to group tasks. awork API: GET /projects/{projectId}/tasklists.

project_id.description: The project id (UUID, from a list call).

annotations.title: List task lists of a project

tools.name: awork_list_task_statuses
tools.title: List task statuses of a project
tools.description: List the task statuses (workflow steps) of one project. Their ids are needed to set a task's status. awork API: GET /projects/{projectId}/taskstatuses.

project_id.description: The project id (UUID, from a list call).

annotations.title: List task statuses of a project

tools.name: awork_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Return one task by id: name, status, assignees, due date, planned duration and parent task. awork API: GET /tasks/{taskId}.

task_id.description: The task id (UUID, from a list call).

tools.name: awork_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List client companies in the workspace. awork API: GET /companies.

orderby.description: Sort expression, as in the awork ordering docs (developers.awork.com/ordering).

filterby.description: Filter expression, as in the awork filtering docs (developers.awork.com/filtering).

tools.name: awork_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Return one company by id. awork API: GET /companies/{companyId}.

company_id.description: The company id (UUID, from a list call).

tools.name: awork_list_types_of_work
tools.title: List types of work
tools.description: List the types of work (billing and activity categories). Their ids are needed to create a time entry. awork API: GET /typeofwork.

orderby.description: Sort expression, as in the awork ordering docs (developers.awork.com/ordering).

filterby.description: Filter expression, as in the awork filtering docs (developers.awork.com/filtering).

tools.name: awork_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries in the workspace (the API key has admin-level access): duration, user, task, project and billable state. awork API: GET /timeentries.

orderby.description: Sort expression, as in the awork ordering docs (developers.awork.com/ordering).

filterby.description: Filter expression, as in the awork filtering docs (developers.awork.com/filtering).

tools.name: awork_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get a time entry
tools.description: Return one time entry by id. awork API: GET /timeentries/{timeEntryId}.

time_entry_id.description: The time entry id (UUID, from a list call).

tools.name: awork_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a project task (baseType projecttask, entityId = project id) or a private task (baseType private, entityId = user id). Creates a new task each call. awork API: POST /tasks.

baseType.description: projecttask for a project task, private for a personal task.

entityId.description: Owner id: the project id for projecttask, the user id for private.

parentId.description: Parent task id, to create a subtask in the same project.

tools.name: awork_add_task_comment
tools.title: Add a task comment
tools.description:
Post a comment on a task. HTML such as

is allowed. Each call posts a new comment. awork API: POST /tasks/{taskId}/comments.

task_id.description: The task id (UUID, from a list call).

message.description: Comment text (HTML allowed). Mention users with ~[userId:<id>].

tools.name: awork_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create a time entry
tools.description: Log time for a user. Give startDateUtc plus either duration (seconds) or endDateUtc. Each call creates a new entry. awork API: POST /timeentries.

userId.description: The user id (UUID, from a list call).

typeOfWorkId.description: The type of work id (UUID, from a list call).

duration.description: Duration in seconds (use this or endDateUtc).
